reason: An embedded administration utility for monitoring the DeepSeek Harness version and manually or automatically updating and restarting its web service; human review is appropriate because it performs global package installation and service control.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中查看版本状态、检查更新、更新程序并重启 Web 服务的管理插件。
summaries.en: An administration plugin for viewing DeepSeek Harness version status, checking for updates, updating the package, and restarting the web service from the embedded interface.

capabilities: Displays service and package version status in an embedded web interface
Checks the npm latest version of @deepseek-ai/dsh
Schedules and executes service restart commands through systemd or fallback restart mechanisms
